en-GB.title: ClipInspector
en-GB.description: An application for searching and evaluating terms.
en-GB.start_intro: Enter a technical term above or choose a working mode.
en-GB.inspector_start_intro: Paste text to find and evaluate the technical terms it contains.
en-GB.translator_start_intro: Paste text to compare detected technical terms with their preferred target-language terms.
en-GB.paste_searchField: Paste text into the search field using the clipboard.
